title: "Why Didn't I Get My Report?"
description: "Which automated reports and emails go out, who gets them, when, and the most common reasons one doesn't arrive."
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
---

Most reports are emailed automatically from **data@teachinglab.org** or **research@teachinglab.org**. If you're expecting one, check your spam folder and search for those addresses first.

## Quick lookup

| Report | Who gets it | When | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Daily facilitator report](#daily-facilitator-report) | The facilitator, CC'ing the site's project team | Weekday mornings, covering the previous day | 3+ [Participant Feedback](survey_glossary.qmd#pf) responses for you and that course, and your session on the site's PL logistics board |
| [Classroom observation report](#classroom-observation-report) | The coach selected in the survey | After the [IPG](survey_glossary.qmd#ipg) observation is submitted | Your name picked from the coach list, not **Other** |
| [Bi-weekly facilitator and coaching summaries](#bi-weekly-summaries) | Program leads and coach developers | 1st and 15th of each month | Nothing on your end |
| [Weekly project log summaries](#weekly-project-log-summaries) | Managers and project leads | Thursday mornings | Project log hours submitted for the week |

Want to see your feedback without waiting for an email? [Individual Feedback](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/individual_feedback/) shows your own Participant Feedback results anytime, signed in with your Google account.

## Daily facilitator report

After you facilitate, you get one report per course with that day's [Participant Feedback](survey_glossary.qmd#pf) results.

- **When:** it isn't sent the moment participants submit. It goes out early the next weekday morning and covers the previous day. Monday's email covers Friday through Sunday.
- **To:** you, at your firstname.lastname@teachinglab.org address. The project leads, CPMs, coach developers, and instructional designers for that site are CC'd, based on the [FY27 Project Staffing Match](https://teachinglab.monday.com/boards/6902955796) board.

You won't get a report when:

- **Fewer than 3 participants** picked you and that course. This protects participants' anonymity.
- **Your session isn't on that site's PL logistics board** for the past week. The report is only sent when the facilitator and site in the survey match a session on the board. Find your site's board from the [FY27 Logistics Boards: L&R Hub](https://teachinglab.monday.com/boards/18416005880).
- **Participants picked Other** instead of your name. If your name wasn't in the list, see [Why Isn't My Name on the Survey?](survey_lists.qmd#facilitators-and-courses-participant-feedback)
- **Participants picked a different site or course** than the one you facilitated.

## Classroom observation report

When a coach submits a [Classroom Observation (IPG)](survey_glossary.qmd#ipg), the report is sent to the coach selected in the survey.

The most common reason it doesn't arrive is that the coach picked **Other** and typed their name because they weren't on the list. A response filed under Other isn't linked to you, so the report doesn't reach you. To get on the list, see [Coaches: Classroom Observation and Student Work](survey_lists.qmd#coaches-classroom-observation-and-student-work).

Individual observation responses are also in [IPG Raw Data / Downloads](https://tl-data.teachinglab.org/ipg_raw_reports/).

## Bi-weekly summaries

On the 1st and 15th of each month, program leads and coach developers get a summary of the past two weeks of [Participant Feedback](survey_glossary.qmd#pf): one for facilitation and one for coaching. These aren't sent to individual facilitators.

## Weekly project log summaries

Every Thursday morning:

- **Managers** get a summary of their direct reports' project log hours for the week.
- **Project leads and sponsors** get a summary of their project team's hours.

If someone's hours are missing, check that they submitted the weekly project log. If you're a manager or lead and didn't get the email, your email may be missing from the employee or staffing records. Contact the data team.

## Still missing?

Email the data team at [duncan.gates@teachinglab.org](mailto:duncan.gates@teachinglab.org) with the report you expected, the date and site of the session or observation, and the name that was selected in the survey.
